decisions.briefing: Markets are risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.1% and S&P 500 +0.6%, so per our strategy of deploying idle cash into confirmed setups on green days, we're filling all 3 open slots with the highest-scoring, multi-signal-confirmed candidates: SKYD, INFQ, and SEI. Existing positions are held unchanged since the market is constructive, not a reason to exit winners.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market gains today, led by NASDAQ's 1.1% rise, reflect continued risk appetite among investors favoring growth and momentum names. The S&P 500's smaller 0.6% gain suggests tech and small/mid-cap momentum stocks are outperforming the broader index. This kind of breadth-with-leadership pattern often signals investors rotating into higher-beta names during risk-on phases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍向好,納斯達克指數上升1.1%,反映投資者風險偏好持續升溫,資金流向增長及動能股。標普500指數升幅較溫和,只有0.6%,顯示科技股及中小型動能股表現優於大盤。這種「領漲股跑贏大盤」的格局,通常意味著資金在風險偏好上升時轉向高貝塔(高波動)股份。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD crossover happens when a stock's MACD line moves above its signal line, often signaling the start of upward momentum. Traders combine it with other signals like rising RSI and volume surges to confirm a genuine trend shift rather than a false signal. Today's buys (SKYD, INFQ, SEI) all showed this pattern alongside confirming volume and price strength.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD黃金交叉是指股票的MACD線升穿訊號線,通常代表上升動能開始形成。交易者會配合其他指標,例如RSI上升及成交量放大,來確認這是真正的趨勢轉變,而非假訊號。今日買入的SKYD、INFQ及SEI均同時出現此訊號,並有成交量及股價走勢配合確認。
